name: Light Disc
note: A glowing disc on a dark grid. Eight ring segments light with the voice; while thinking the disc turns and two light trails, cyan and orange, race the grid in right angles behind it; while answering the rings pulse with the reply.

vars.p_lok: !(p_nx + p_dy * gs < gs || p_nx + p_dy * gs > w - gs || p_ny - p_dx * gs < gs || p_ny - p_dx * gs > h - gs)
vars.p_rok: !(p_nx - p_dy * gs < gs || p_nx - p_dy * gs > w - gs || p_ny + p_dx * gs < gs || p_ny + p_dx * gs > h - gs)
vars.p_want: mod(p_rnd, 100) < 30 || (p_nx + p_dx * gs < gs || p_nx + p_dx * gs > w - gs || p_ny + p_dy * gs < gs || p_ny + p_dy * gs > h - gs)

p_x.next: !st ? 2 * gs : (p_arr ? p_nx + p_ndx * (adv - p_rem) : p_x + p_dx * adv)

p_y.next: !st ? 2 * gs : (p_arr ? p_ny + p_ndy * (adv - p_rem) : p_y + p_dy * adv)

vars.q_lok: !(q_nx + q_dy * gs < gs || q_nx + q_dy * gs > w - gs || q_ny - q_dx * gs < gs || q_ny - q_dx * gs > h - gs)
vars.q_rok: !(q_nx - q_dy * gs < gs || q_nx - q_dy * gs > w - gs || q_ny + q_dx * gs < gs || q_ny + q_dx * gs > h - gs)
vars.q_want: mod(q_rnd, 100) < 30 || (q_nx + q_dx * gs < gs || q_nx + q_dx * gs > w - gs || q_ny + q_dy * gs < gs || q_ny + q_dy * gs > h - gs)

q_c0x.next: !st ? floor((w - 2 * gs) / gs) * gs : (q_arr && q_pick != 0 ? q_c1x : q_c0x)

q_c0y.next: !st ? floor((h - 2 * gs) / gs) * gs : (q_arr && q_pick != 0 ? q_c1y : q_c0y)

q_c1x.next: !st ? floor((w - 2 * gs) / gs) * gs : (q_arr && q_pick != 0 ? q_c2x : q_c1x)

q_c1y.next: !st ? floor((h - 2 * gs) / gs) * gs : (q_arr && q_pick != 0 ? q_c2y : q_c1y)

q_c2x.next: !st ? floor((w - 2 * gs) / gs) * gs : (q_arr && q_pick != 0 ? q_c3x : q_c2x)

q_c2y.next: !st ? floor((h - 2 * gs) / gs) * gs : (q_arr && q_pick != 0 ? q_c3y : q_c2y)

q_c3x.next: !st ? floor((w - 2 * gs) / gs) * gs : (q_arr && q_pick != 0 ? q_c4x : q_c3x)

q_c3y.next: !st ? floor((h - 2 * gs) / gs) * gs : (q_arr && q_pick != 0 ? q_c4y : q_c3y)

q_c4x.next: !st ? floor((w - 2 * gs) / gs) * gs : (q_arr && q_pick != 0 ? q_nx : q_c4x)

q_c4y.next: !st ? floor((h - 2 * gs) / gs) * gs : (q_arr && q_pick != 0 ? q_ny : q_c4y)

q_x.next: !st ? floor((w - 2 * gs) / gs) * gs : (q_arr ? q_nx + q_ndx * (adv - q_rem) : q_x + q_dx * adv)

q_y.next: !st ? floor((h - 2 * gs) / gs) * gs : (q_arr ? q_ny + q_ndy * (adv - q_rem) : q_y + q_dy * adv)

items.note: cyan light trail, newest segment first, 6.3 cells long

let.used: (j > 0) * (abs(p_x - p_c4x) + abs(p_y - p_c4y)) + (j > 1) * (abs(p_c4x - p_c3x) + abs(p_c4y - p_c3y)) + (j > 2) * (abs(p_c3x - p_c2x) + abs(p_c3y - p_c2y)) + (j > 3) * (abs(p_c2x - p_c1x) + abs(p_c2y - p_c1y))

items.note: orange light trail, newest segment first, 6.3 cells long

let.used: (j > 0) * (abs(q_x - q_c4x) + abs(q_y - q_c4y)) + (j > 1) * (abs(q_c4x - q_c3x) + abs(q_c4y - q_c3y)) + (j > 2) * (abs(q_c3x - q_c2x) + abs(q_c3y - q_c2y)) + (j > 3) * (abs(q_c2x - q_c1x) + abs(q_c2y - q_c1y))

items.note: dark fill hides the trails behind the disc
eight segments light with the voice; one runs round while thinking

let.on: (1 - mode) * clamp01(level * 1.4 * band) + think * (k == lit ? 1 : 0.35) + answer * (0.3 + 0.7 * level * band)
